variants.prompt: A free-spirited young woman with fiery red hair in loose, tousled waves lounges seductively on a plush, velvet chaise in a dimly lit, opulent boudoir. Emerald green eyes smolder with invitation as she runs a manicured finger along the curve of a champagne flute, her porcelain skin glowing under the soft candlelight. Shallow depth of field blurs the ornate furnishings behind her, focusing the viewer's attention solely on her alluring presence.
